ontology.name: Electric Range / Oven
ontology.description: Canonical functional diagnostic ontology for electric freestanding ranges and ovens. Models functional relationships and diagnostic dependencies; switching mechanisms, zone elements, and manufacturer PCB architectures belong in platform overlays.
ontology.frozenNote: CG-10 rev1 — four-manual discovery (W11746350, LG-LRE-RANGE, W11174426, SAMSUNG-NE58-RANGE boundary). Five KEEP components; two instance scopes; one conditional instance scope; three conditional concepts; oven_heating_system removed. Locked by CG10_ELECTRIC_RANGE_FREEZE_LOCK_v1.json.

designPrinciples: Model functional heat generation and control behavior — not infinite switches, relay PCBs, sub-PCBs, or per-zone radiant element hardware.
Separate power, control, user interface, cavity temperature feedback, surface heat generation, and oven heat generation diagnostically.

Oven heat generation is a functional domain with instance-scoped diagnostic functions (bake, broil, convection) — not one opaque oven_heating_system node and not three universal canonical component types.
surface_heating_system is the cooktop functional domain; control_board → surface_heating_system is invariant across infinite-switch, relay, and knob implementations.
INSTANCE_SCOPE concepts live in instanceScopes[] — they enable reasoning like 'bake element failed' without promoting bake_heating_element to a universal canonical component type.
CONDITIONAL concepts require platform procedure evidence before graph participation — do not blindly promote convection_fan, thermal_protection, or oven_door_switch.
Platform-only vocabulary (surface_control, surface_heating_element, door_latch_motor, oven_lamp) must not auto-promote from overlay exposure.
Tests produce evidence; evidence changes component and hypothesis state (handled in procedure + intelligence layers).
Do not condemn downstream heat actuators until required upstream control and authorization conditions are established.
Unknown information must remain unknown — never infer good or bad without evidence.
Procedure branch logic and test definitions stay in service procedure seeds, not in this file.

ontologyContract.canonicalComponentRule: components[] lists only triangulated KEEP nodes with cross-manufacturer functional recurrence within the electric range family.
ontologyContract.instanceScopeRule: instanceScopes[] lists diagnostic functions under a functional domain — NOT separate canonical component types. Solomon may reason about instance-scoped failures without universal canonical promotion.
ontologyContract.conditionalConceptRule: Evidence-backed functional role that is not universally instantiated or requires platform-specific test packaging — encoded in conditionalConcepts[], not components[].
ontologyContract.componentsVsInstanceScopes: The distinction between components[] and instanceScopes[] is load-bearing CG-10 architecture — preserve in all rev1 consumers.
ontologyContract.implementationNotOntology: Switching mechanisms (infinite_switch, relay PCB, sub PCB relay bank) are platform knowledge — never canonical nodes.

instanceScopes.name: Bake heating function
instanceScopes.freezeRationale: Dedicated bake procedure on LG, LCX, and Samsung; instance-scoped diagnostic function — not a universal canonical component type.

instanceScopes.name: Broil heating function
instanceScopes.freezeRationale: Independent broil test on R2/R3/R4 — instance scope under oven heat generation domain.

conditionalInstanceScopes.name: Convection heating function
conditionalInstanceScopes.conditionalRule: Include when platform manual evidences dedicated electric convection element test; omit on platforms without convection heat path (e.g. LCX R3).

conditionalConcepts.freezeRationale: LG R2 and Samsung R4 provide dedicated convection fan motor tests; R3 LCX documents fan behavior without fan procedure; R1 vent/convection ambiguity.
Protection behavior is real but implementation paths diverge across fuse proc, sensor route, and thermostat continuity — platform vocabulary, not one canonical component.
Door authorization function recurs; test packaging varies (standalone switch vs latch-embedded logic).

removedFromRev1.reason: Monolithic aggregate rejected R2–R4 — heat generation is a functional domain with instance-scoped functions, not one opaque canonical node.

overlayOnlyConcepts.reason: Infinite switch, ACU relay, cooktop relay PCB, sub PCB relay — implementation switching paths; invariant is control_board → surface_heating_system.
Physical radiant/bridge/ceran elements and per-zone Ω tests — overlay scope under surface_heating_system.
Self-clean latch motor/micro-switch actuator — platform knowledge; door authorization may bind via conditional oven_door_switch.
Accessory lamp test — platform overlay only.

deferredConcepts.reason: No dedicated electronics cooling fan procedure distinct from convection fan across R1–R4.
No standalone cavity diagnostic procedure on any discovery manual.
Optional LG feature — insufficient cross-manufacturer triangulation for rev1.

componentStateModel.description: Component verification states for this ontology. Distinct from intelligence-engine hypothesis ranking.
componentStateModel.engineSeparationNote: Diagnostic ranking, candidate support, and routing effects do not constitute component verification. verified_good and verified_failed require explicit diagnostic evidence.

systems.name: Power
systems.purpose: Mains supply prerequisite for control and heat loads.

systems.name: Control
systems.purpose: Oven and cooktop sequencing, relay/switch orchestration, and safety logic.

systems.name: User Interface
systems.purpose: Touch/keypad input, display, and service-mode entry.

systems.name: Oven Temperature Sensing
systems.purpose: Cavity temperature feedback for bake/broil/convection control.

systems.name: Surface Heat Generation
systems.purpose: Cooktop heat generation functional domain — zone elements are platform overlay.

systems.name: Oven Heat Generation
systems.purpose: Functional domain for bake/broil/convection instance-scoped diagnostic functions — not a monolithic component.

components.name: Control board
components.note: Functional orchestration node — relay/sub-PCB hardware names are platform overlay vocabulary, not separate canonical components.

components.name: Surface heating system
components.note: Cooktop functional domain — per-zone radiant elements and infinite-switch paths are platform overlay scope.

relationships.note: Line voltage to cooktop loads — switching path is platform overlay.
R3+R4 invariant — implementation switching (infinite_switch, relay) stays platform-only.
Cavity temperature feedback — oven heat instance scopes bind in overlay, not as separate canonical nodes.

functionalDependencies.description: Control and heat loads require verified mains supply.
Control board responsive and able to command loads.
Cooktop heat generation requires control command to surface_heating_system functional domain.
functionalDependencies.note: Zone element and infinite-switch diagnostics bind in platform overlay — not canonical component expansion.

functionalDependencies.description: Oven heat generation requires control readiness; bake/broil/convection are instance-scoped functions under oven_heat_generation domain.
functionalDependencies.note: Instance scopes bake_heating_element, broil_heating_element, convection_heating_element bind in instanceScopes[] — not components[]. oven_door_switch is conditional — bind when platform provides distinct door authorization test.

functionalDependencies.description: Cavity temperature control requires oven RTD/thermistor feedback.

general.rule: Establish mains supply before condemning control or heat paths.
Establish control readiness before condemning surface or oven heat actuators.
Bake/broil/convection failures bind to instanceScopes[] — do not promote to universal canonical components.
Infinite switches, relay PCBs, and sub-PCB hardware are platform knowledge — never canonical nodes.
Do not instantiate conditional concepts as verified components without platform overlay scope.
Negative or incomplete evidence should reduce candidate support without manufacturing verification.

diagnosticEntryPoints.note: Route to instanceScopes.bake_heating_element via platform overlay — not oven_heating_system aggregate.
Route to instanceScopes.broil_heating_element via platform overlay.
